Here is why I STRONGLY recommend the services of Joe Snee and his company Guided Elevator. We bought a house in Santa Barbara, California about one year ago with an Inclinator Elevette MRL elevator that accesses the second floor. It is one of the reasons that we bought the house. The elevator did not work. The previous owner, unfortunately, did not provide us any information about the elevator or its maintenance history. We were on or own and began calling elevator repair companies in the region. Several responded and some came to inspect the elevator. A few simply declined to service the elevator. One company could not get the manufacturer to provide any guidance. Another company inspected the elevator and then refused to service it because they had not originally installed it. Then we called yet another company and they told us they could fix it. But once they did the inspection, they informed us that we would need parts that were no longer available, so they told us a modification (basically a replacement) would be necessary. They sent us an estimate of $34,000 for the modification. We were at our wits end, but we had one more phone number that was provided to us by the manufacturer. So we called Joe at Guided Elevator, explained our situation, and he suggested that we invite his son Josh to come up from the Los Angeles area to repair the elevator. He came up and it was immediately obvious that he was an expert on elevator repair, especially Inclinator models. He had all the specialized diagnostic tools necessary to diagnose the system. All the circuit boards check out fine. In the end, all we needed were new ball bearing rollers and we replaced the backup batteries because they were about fifteen years old. The total cost, including the extra charges for two trips’ drive time from LA was about $1800. The elevator now works perfectly. These guys know what they are doing and they are honest.

My residential elevator was down, and a friend recommended Josh. I previously used a large company, and let me say I wish I had found Him earlier!! Highly recommend him and a nice guy too!

We just bought a house in Pasadena with a 30-yr old elevator.  As luck would have it, the HVAC repair guys didn't securely close the inside accordion door, leading to our elevator getting stuck between floors.  Oh, and this was DAYS before our movers were scheduled to arrive.  Without the assistance of the elevator, the movers would have to trek every single box and piece of furniture a minimum of 3 sets of stairs.  I called no less than 12 elevator companies off of yelp -- I started getting more and more nervous as I left messages for one- and two-star rated companies.  Only a handful called me back and of those, some said they didn't work on residential elevators at all, others wanted to charge for their commute time in addition to $500+ service fees, others said they wouldn't work on our elevator bc it didn't have a phone line set up yet, and others didn't have availability for over a week.  Thankfully, my husband remembered that my realtor had mentioned recently selling another house with an elevator, and that's how we got Josh's contact info.

Here's where Josh came in - and why you should hire him, full stop.  He answered immediately when I called him, listened to me explain the issue and tried to help me diagnose the problem over the phone.  Right away, he theorized that the inner accordion door had been left open (which ended up being exactly the issue) and thought it would be an easy fix.  He suggest I try a couple things when I went to see the elevator the next day, but none worked.  He had a busy week but understood our moving dilemma, so he moved around some things and was able to come the very next day to take a look.  Before I even got to the house, he was already done!!  He walked me through what he had done, checked the doors on each floor, gave me some tips on how to avoid future problems, and advised me on what I could do if someone was stuck.

In a nutshell - Josh was awesome.  I went from panicking about expensive elevator repairs and a rescheduled move to being way more informed about my elevator and how it works.  Josh was responsive, super helpful and attentive, and clearly knows his stuff.  He's been working on elevators for over 20+ years, his business is a family one (not a mega corporation), and he clearly has a personal pride in his work.  His rates are very reasonable!  But more importantly, I feel like I can trust him to not be upselling me on fees or repairs or replacements that can be avoided.  We are so, so glad we found him.
